Add a frontmatter-emission helper to scripts/doc-gen/utils.js: foundationFrontmatter({subject, documents, related_files}) returning a YAML block with status: generated + subject + optional documents:/related_files: lists (repo-relative posix paths). Deterministic ordering, no timestamps inside frontmatter (regen must be diff-stable when inputs are unchanged).

Lane 1: prepend generator-derived frontmatter in all four full-regeneration generators. HOTSPOTS derives documents: from its own analyzed top-files list; EXPORTS from export-bearing files (cap the list; disclose truncation in a comment key if capped); INDEX and RELATIONSHIPS emit subject + status: generated with related_files only if a mechanical derivation exists (no invented claims). Flip the deliberate hold in src/pipeline/doc-ingest.ts foundation loop: read documents: from the parsed frontmatter (parseDocFrontmatter already runs) instead of hardcoding documentsPath: undefined. Keep docStatus: 'generated' (ranking contract DR-DOCS-E unchanged: generated never outranks approved/draft prose). Update the header comment (the 'revisit when a producer actually stamps them' breadcrumb) to reflect the new contract.

Regenerate: run the four lane-1 generators + enhance-existing-docs.js against this repo (--project-dir .), run validate-docs.js (exit 0 required), run enhance-existing-docs.js TWICE to prove idempotence (second run = zero diff), then full scan and verify graph.json: 8 foundation @Doc nodes now carry documents edges where derivable, 0 dangling resolved edges, GI gates green.
